title: An absent key in one array says nothing about another array

ground_truth.statement: The nested isset can be either true or false, independently of the preceding array's missing key. However nonempty mixed values are not necessarily valid array offsets: a nonempty array reaches the offset operation and throws. Redundancy reports are wrong; mixed-offset safety reports are correct.

provenance.derivation: Upstream ignores MixedArrayOffset. Kept the mixed input, removed that suppression, and added both guard outcomes plus an invalid-offset control.

notes: Valid-provider status is not a clean oracle because the upstream harness ignores a genuine offset hazard. PHPStan and Psalm diagnose the mixed offsets on lines 9 and 10. Mago is silent, retained as FN. No tool reports a spurious redundant guard.
